scope: Local Slidev and Vue hot reload

checks: A consumer Vue SFC imports public components/composable, customizes a card slot and navigates to a slide and back
All home/card slots render real Vue content, events work, and category v-model synchronizes in both directions
Reactive catalog updates replace cards with the caller-provided empty slot
useCatalog exposes loading/error/reload, watches source refs, rejects stale results, and aborts requests on unmount
Home and live thumbnails work without a static site build
Vue home edits hot-update without a document reload
Markdown hot-updates in place on page 2; home metadata and thumbnail revision update
Catalog refresh preserves category selection and regenerates changed cover pixels
Adding a slide updates the catalog and new deep link
Syntax errors show an overlay, a valid save recovers, and rapid saves converge on the latest content
Different themes and encoded deck paths work, with return navigation

qualityGates.thumbnailLayoutReady: passed: waits for asynchronous layout before capture; all five official covers visually verified
qualityGates.pollingWatchers: passed: 200ms polling avoids host inotify instance exhaustion

limitations: Adding or removing deck entries and changing profile assignments requires restarting the dev server.
Changes to compiler configuration/features may restart the affected Slidev runtime and reload its page.
Development mode verified with Slidev 53.0.0 on Linux; Native and cloud deployment were not rerun.
